FEB Overview

Source: R/feb.R
feb_overview.Rd

Today's (or the latest) games of every live FEB competition, with scores and status.

Endpoint: GET https://intrafeb.feb.es/LiveStats.API/api/v1/overview

One row per game across the competitions with games in the window. An off day with no competitions raises hoopR_no_data; a game listed under another competition is refused (hoopR_asset_fetch).

Usage

feb_overview()

Value

A hoopR_data tibble with these columns:

col_nametypedescription
comp_idintegerCompetition id (constant across seasons): 115 Primera FEB (LEB Oro), 118 Segunda FEB, 210 Liga Femenina Endesa, 214 LF Challenge, 218 LF-2, 111 Tercera FEB. Not the site's menu group.
comp_codeintegerSeason-specific competition edition code (e.g. 23473 = Primera FEB 2026-27).
competitioncharacterCompetition name as printed that season, uppercase ('PRIMERA FEB'; 2020-21 'LIGA LEB ORO').
game_idintegerFEB game id (one global sequence): the {gameId} of every LiveStats route.
round_idintegerRound id; 0 in every sample (the route does not fill it).
stagecharacterStage code as a string; '0' in every sample (meaning unverified).
venuecharacterName of the venue (pabellon) where the game is played.
start_timePOSIXctTip-off in Spanish local time (POSIXct, tz Europe/Madrid; the source has no offset).
start_time_utcPOSIXctTip-off in UTC (POSIXct, tz UTC).
periodintegerCurrent or last period (4 when finished).
clockcharacter'FINAL' once finished, else the game clock ('00:00' before tip-off).
statusintegerGame state code: 3 = finished, 1 = scheduled (seen 2026-10-12); the live codes are unverified.
home_team_idintegerHome team-season id (new every season; joins the schedule pages).
home_teamcharacterHome team name for the season.
home_team_codecharacterHome federation team code, 8 digits as a string.
home_club_codecharacterHome federation club code, 6 digits as a string.
home_abbreviationcharacterHome team three-letter abbreviation ('PAL').
home_scoreintegerHome points (0 before tip-off).
away_team_idintegerAway team-season id (new every season; joins the schedule pages).
away_teamcharacterAway team name for the season.
away_team_codecharacterAway federation team code, 8 digits as a string.
away_club_codecharacterAway federation club code, 6 digits as a string.
away_abbreviationcharacterAway team three-letter abbreviation.
away_scoreintegerAway points (0 before tip-off).
period_scorescharacterPoints per period as 'home-away' pairs joined by ';' ('16-16;19-16;10-21;14-14'); null before tip-off.

Details

The Spanish Basketball Federation (FEB) wrappers cover Primera FEB, Segunda FEB and Liga Femenina Endesa (plus the federation's other groups on the same routes). They mirror sdv-py's sportsdataverse.basketball.feb wrappers of the same names: same arguments, the same snake_case columns and types, one row per sdv-py row.

Legal notice. The FEB's aviso legal (legal notice) asserts intellectual-property rights over the site's content and its databases (the EU database right). It has no explicit scraping clause, and robots.txt answers 404 on both hosts. Fetching for your own use on your own machine is how these wrappers are meant to be used; check the notice before you republish the data.

Unofficial and unsupported. The LiveStats API (intrafeb.feb.es) is the federation's own widget backend, not a documented public API. It needs a bearer token, which is public: it is read from the home page of baloncestoenvivo.feb.es at run time, kept in memory for the R session (24 h validity, renewed once on an HTTP 401) and never printed, logged or written. Requests are spaced at least one second apart per host; 429 and 5xx answers are retried (three attempts).

Coverage. The game routes answer from 2020-21 (Liga Femenina Endesa from its first game; Primera FEB from 2021-03-12, so its earlier 2020-21 games and every earlier season answer 404). 2020-21 play-by-play is text only. The schedule pages go back to 1996-97 (season = 1997).

Seasons are END years (season = 2027 is 2026-27); the site's own t key is the START year, so the request sends t = season - 1.

Errors are classed conditions, never a warning plus an empty frame: hoopR_no_data (HTTP 404, an unknown group, a schedule page with no games, an empty overview window), hoopR_bad_request (HTTP 400 / 422, or a game_id, group or season that is not a non-negative integer) and hoopR_asset_fetch (any other failure: another status, a transport error, a token the API still rejects after one renewal, a non-JSON or non-HTML body, an error or changed envelope, a play-by-play of another game, a page for another group or season, or layout drift). All inherit hoopR_error.

 feb_overview()
